mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 6 months signals an easing monetary cycle, lowering discount rates applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in <30% of triggered instances despite FEDFUNDS declining, or the 20d returns are not statistically significant (p>0.05) in a t-test against baseline.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in unemployment rate below 5.0% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, reflecting market anxiety about labor market tightness.
failure_condition: SPX returns remain positive despite UNRATE crossing above 5.0%, or the returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) compared to a baseline period.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in federal funds rates and rise in quarterly GDP demand pressures compress discount rates and boost equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < previous month AND GDPC1 > previous month
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) despite the interaction, or the interaction occurs but returns move in the opposite direction.

mechanism_narrative: Inflation exceeding 2% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors anticipate higher interest rates and reduced equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX returns remain positive despite CPIAUCSL exceeding 2.0%, or the returns are not statistically significant (p>0.05) compared to a baseline period.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in monthly retail sales (RSAFS) signals weakening demand, prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative despite RSAFS declining in the late-cycle regime, or the returns are not statistically significant (p>0.05) against a baseline.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in industrial production (supply) and housing starts (demand) signals robust economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both HOUST and INDPRO increase in the same month
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) despite the interaction, or the 60d returns move in the opposite direction.

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged federal funds rate above 4% for two consecutive months signals persistent monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate higher inflation.
failure_condition: SPX returns remain positive despite FEDFUNDS staying above 4% for two months, or the returns are not statistically significant (p>0.05) compared to baseline.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 145,000 triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, reflecting improved labor market confidence.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative despite PAYEMS exceeding 145,000, or the returns are not statistically significant (p>0.05) compared to a baseline period.
